title: Desert Hills with Mountains
description: A person sees a wide desert plain covered in bright orange sand with clumps of dark spiky grass and bushes in the foreground. In the distance are rolling tan and brown hills that lead to a range of blue mountains with white peaks under a large empty white sky.
